title: Workflow vs. Agent: a Policy-vs-Script Perspective
excerpt: Reframes the distinction as scripted orchestration (developers fix topology, guards, and stop conditions at design time) versus policy-driven orchestration (an LLM chooses actions, tools, parameters, and stop conditions at runtime). Describes three hybrid patterns that ship in production: workflow-in-agent (agent delegates to deterministic sub-steps), agent-in-workflow (workflow backbone with agentic nodes), and agent-using-workflow-as-tool.
